build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a V-shaped cradle with a ball and target bar
create_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene at a specified center and bottom position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to require the ball touching the target bar using SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to mark the solution tier as BALL type
